name: circuit-musicfx
features: Audio from a loaded track, the mic or the demo drives the visuals on beats.
Circuit mode builds a random circuit board that lights traces on beats, and new board rebuilds it.
Modes switch between circuit, ASCII bars, matrix rain, tetris, snake, pong and terminal.
Terminal mode has Linux, hacker, Kali, Android, paper, Windows and PowerShell themes and a build mode that types source.
